column1: # Compressed-mode proving, measured 2026-08-26 on an M4 Max, machine idle.
# The first compressed measurements this project has taken. Before the
# zerocheck fix, compressed proofs did not complete: 0 of 10 attempts.
# Three runs an arm, both arms through one binary, 4 MiB shards.
# This is the quantity D7's bar is written against -- execute to compressed
# proof -- and at ~3x it does not clear the 5x bar. Core proving on the same
# machine is 5.57x, so recursion roughly halves the backend's advantage.
